title: The Top Two Best-Selling Games On Steam Right Now Are Upcoming Xbox Game Pass Titles
summary:
Making bank on Steam too.

You'd be forgiven for thinking that whenever a game launches into Xbox Game Pass on day one, it probably doesn't sell too well outside of the service - and while that certainly can happen, it's not always the case. Sometimes games are just so popular that they shift plenty of standalone units too, and that seems to be the situation for two upcoming May 2026 XGP releases.

SteamDB recently shared sales data for the week of May 5-12 (thanks, Windows Central), and it shows that Forza Horizon 6 and Subnautica 2 took up the top two spots on the list for best-selling games on the platform. Both titles are also set to launch on Xbox Game Pass in the coming days.

Is this finally the year of Banjo-Kazooie?

We've just checked the calendar and realised that we're less than a month away from the big Xbox Games Showcase 2026! For those who aren't aware, this typically marks Xbox's most important event of the year, putting a spotlight on tons of upcoming games from both first and third-party developers.

Details are limited on what we'll be seeing in this year's showcase, but we do know that Gears of War: E-Day will be getting its own lengthy section at the end of the event, while the likes of Fable and Halo: Campaign Evolved are bound to show up (along with plenty of surprises).

title: The Top Two Best-Selling Games On Steam Right Now Are Upcoming Xbox Game Pass Titles
summary:
Making bank on Steam too.

You'd be forgiven for thinking that whenever a game launches into Xbox Game Pass on day one, it probably doesn't sell too well outside of the service - and while that certainly can happen, it's not always the case. Sometimes games are just so popular that they shift plenty of standalone units too, and that seems to be the situation for two upcoming May 2026 XGP releases.

SteamDB recently shared sales data for the week of May 5-12 (thanks, Windows Central), and it shows that Forza Horizon 6 and Subnautica 2 took up the top two spots on the list for best-selling games on the platform. Both titles are also set to launch on Xbox Game Pass in the coming days.

title: Rumour: Project Helix Unlikely To Include Disc Drive, But Xbox May Have A Digital Solution
summary:
"Take this with a huge pinch of salt and a healthy dose of speculation".

We've been pondering for a while now about whether Xbox might choose to avoid including a disc drive in the next-gen Project Helix console, and a new report suggests that might indeed be the case.

Windows Central's Jez Corden has mentioned that based on "hints" he's received about the nature of Xbox Project Helix, it will be "a fully digital system, similar to today's gaming PCs, laptops, and most modern devices".

title: Forza Horizon 6 Progression Methods Detailed, Including A New 'Horizon Play' Feature
summary:
Three main ways to progress.

In the build up to Forza Horizon 6, much has been said about the game's progression after concerns about campaign structure following Forza Horizon 5 - and just ahead of launch, the team at Playground Games has gone into more specifics about how you'll progress at Horizon Japan.

The studio has split progression into three main areas: Wristbands, Stamps and Horizon Play. Wristbands you'll have heard about before - they're a returning feature from the first Forza Horizon and are all about completing festival-based races and events.

title: 'NBA The Run' Brings Its NBA Street Vibes To Xbox This June
summary:
Releasing in just a few short weeks.

If you were a fan of NBA Street back in the original Xbox era, you'll want to keep your eye on an upcoming game known as NBA The Run, which is landing on Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S on June 9th, 2026.

The game clearly takes inspiration from NBA Street, and its creative director even worked on all four games in EA's series back in the day, so we have high hopes here! NBA The Run is a primarily online-based 3v3 street basketball game complete with Solos and Squads modes, fast gameplay, rollback netcode and online crossplay.

title: Poll: Which Is Your Favourite Forza Horizon Game To Date?
summary:
Which Horizon Festival have you liked best?

Forza Horizon 6 is upon us! Indeed, if you're drifting in via early access, you can go hands on with Xbox's new racer this Friday — May 15th — so what better time to ask you fine folks which is your favourite Forza Horizon game to date?

The first Horizon game was a bit of a landmark title for Xbox's Forza series. It was the first franchise entry to go open-world and the first to introduce night racing - all wrapped up in a brand-new Horizon Festival setting that took players to Colorado, USA. We still have fond memories of it to this day.
